'''Chernan Ordo''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who held the title of [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']]. During the [[Sith–Imperial War]], Ordo was hired by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] to defend the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Botajef/Legends|Botajef]] against an [[Battle of Botajef|impending attack]] by the [[Imperial Army/Legends|forces]] of the [[Fel Empire]], until the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|Alliance's fleet]] arrived to repel the Imperials. However, the Alliance [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] never arrived; the Mandalorian forces, including Ordo, [[Death/Legends|perished]] as they were overrun and defeated. Fellow Mandalorian [[Yaga Auchs]], who betrayed Ordo by [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotaging]] their communications, usurped the title of ''Mand'alor'' and withdrew the Mandalorians from the conflict.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Karr! We're not getting anything from communications! Find out what the problem is! And see if you can find where ''Yaga Auchs'' is!''"<br />"''On it, Mandalore!|Ordo and Hondo Karr on the battlefield of Botajef|<ref name="Legacy 41" />}}
[[File:Battle_of_Botajef.jpg|thumb|left|170px|Ordo fights Imperial forces on Botajef.]]
Chernan Ordo was a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who ascended to the position of [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']],<ref name="Legacy 41" /> a title that signified a being's absolute authority over the Mandalorian clans,<ref name="TM: P&C">{{InsiderCite|86|The Mandalorians: People and Culture}}</ref> by [[127 ABY]].<ref name="Legacy 41" /> In that same [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Fel Empire]] [[Treaty of Anaxes|declared war]] against the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].<ref name="Legacy 0">[[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0]]</ref> Late in the first year of the conflict, Ordo was contracted by the Alliance to [[Ground warfare/Legends|defend]] the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Botajef/Legends|Botajef]] against the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial forces]] until the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet]] could arrive to protect the world.<ref name="Legacy 41" />

During the [[Battle of Botajef|ensuing battle]] on Botajef's surface, Ordo's Mandalorian forces began to be overrun by the larger number of Imperials, which included [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and [[All Terrain Advance Raider|AT-AR walkers]]. When the Alliance's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] failed to arrive, Ordo instructed the Mandalorian [[Hondo Karr]] to check their communications tower and locate another Mandalorian, [[Yaga Auchs]]. Karr found Auchs, who [[Death/Legends|killed]] the [[Unidentified Mandalorian (Yaga Auchs' victim)|Mandalorian]] monitoring the communications and destroyed the tower on behalf of a [[Yaga Auchs' master|third party]] who did not want the Mandalorians involved in the war. Eventually, Ordo was slain and the Mandalorian forces were defeated due to Auchs' [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] and betrayal. Auchs usurped Ordo's title of Mandalore and withdrew the Mandalorians from the Sith&ndash;Imperial War.<ref name="Legacy 41" />

==Personality and traits==
Chernan Ordo was capable enough of a Mandalorian to claim the title of ''Mand'alor'',<ref name="Legacy 41" /> which designated a being's supremacy as the leader of the Mandalorian clans.<ref name="TM: P&C" /> After willingly accepting payment from the Galactic Alliance to defend Botajef, Ordo came to view the Alliance as treacherous and cowardly due to the Alliance's fleet never arriving to provide assistance. The ''Mand'alor'' also recognized that despite commanding fighters of superior quality, the Imperials had an advantage in the quantity of their forces. Ordo wore a set of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] painted in [[Color/Legends|green]], gray, and yellow, and used a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] during combat.<ref name="Legacy 41" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chernan Ordo first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comics]], within the [[Legacy (2006) 41|forty-first]] issue of the series, entitled ''Rogue's End''. Ordo was drawn by [[Kajo Baldisimo]] and the issue was written by [[John Ostrander]].<ref name="Legacy 41" />
